g.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Each panel holds the seven UTC days after the date shown, each day forecast at 09:00 UTC the day before (leads 15.5 to 39 hours). Dashed black: reading. Lines: median forecast. Bands: 5% to 95% quantiles. Eight weeks were fixed by calendar before any score was read; the ninth is the scored- year week with the largest mean absolute shape, chosen without looking at scores. Unit: points of effective capacity.'
